result.note: Tests the scope of India's October 2026 Black Sea truce proposal and Ukraine's response, a concrete diplomatic initiative.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Black Sea truce proposal India made to Russia and Ukraine in October 2026:
items: It covered energy sites, grain shipments and merchant vessels.
Kyiv called it the broadest of four competing plans on the table.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the story: India's truce plan had three parts covering energy sites, grain shipments and merchant vessels, and Kyiv called it the broadest of the four competing plans. The proposal was made on 8 October 2026.
questions.source: India proposed a three-part Black Sea truce to Russia and Ukraine, covering energy sites, grain shipments, and merchant vessels, which Kyiv called the broadest of four competing plans on the table.
